bio: L’Amitié is depicted by a warm bistro feel and sports a huge street art-inspired fish mural. The focus is on laid-back cuisine oozing with flavour. Quality produce is revered and lovingly presented in small plates free of fripperies and designed to be shared. Delicious cured meats, vintage sardines straight from the tin, slightly seared prawns in a kimchi and pineapple sauce and an extravaganza of passion fruit, bananas and chocolate to finish. If you close your eyes, your tastebuds may well take you on a culinary world tour courtesy of fascinating blends. A place of sanctuary for fans of fine food and friendship....
